description: Live test script covering all nine blocks. You: Shivam. Them: a friend playing Maria (front desk), then Dr. Patel.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Good morning, Cedar Dental, this is Maria.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Hi Maria, this is Shivam from Brightline. Is Dr. Patel available?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Can I ask what it's about?

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: It's about the missed appointments on her schedule. Two minutes at most.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Okay, hold on, I'll put you through.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Dr. Patel speaking.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Hi Dr. Patel, Shivam from Brightline. We help dental clinics fill cancelled appointments, and I'm calling because you just opened a second office.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Could I take thirty seconds to explain why I called? Then you tell me if it's worth more.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Look, I'm really busy, and we already have a reminder system. Just send me an email.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Totally fair, you already send reminders. Can I ask one quick question before I let you go?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Fine, one question.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: When someone cancels the same morning, what happens to that slot today?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Honestly, it usually stays empty. My front desk calls the waitlist by hand, but by the time they reach someone it's too late.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: How often does that happen in a week?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Maybe five or six times. It's a real problem at the new office.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: That's exactly what we fix. When someone cancels, we text your waitlist automatically, and the first person to reply gets the slot, usually within fifteen minutes.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Interesting. Does it work with our booking software? We use Dentrix.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Yes, it syncs both ways, so your front desk doesn't type anything twice.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Okay, what does something like that cost?

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: It depends on the number of chairs. The easiest way is a fifteen minute demo on your own schedule. Would Thursday at eleven or Friday at two work better?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Thursday at eleven works.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Great. What's the best email for the invite?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Send it to patel at cedar dental dot com.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Got it. Thursday at eleven, invite going to patel at cedar dental dot com.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Perfect. I have to get back to a patient now.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Of course. Thanks, Dr. Patel, talk Thursday. Bye.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Bye.
